inputs.checklistItemText: Non-utility-compatible trees proposed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment
inputs.question: On the landscape plan (Sheet 31), where the overhead electric (OHE) lines run along the southern property boundary, are there any trees or plants shown within 15 feet north of that boundary line? List the types of trees/plants if any are present in that 15-foot zone.
inputs.regionHint: southern property boundary where OHE line runs

output.reasoning: The agent is asking for identification of trees/plants within a specific 15-foot lateral distance from the OHE conductor—this is a clearance/distance verification question, not merely a presence check or drawing inspection of symbols. The agent must measure or assess the spatial relationship between vegetation and the conductor boundary.
